title: MapleStory M Equipment Level Up Guide
author: MapleStory M GM
summary: Official equipment-leveling instructions explaining Forge access, material EXP, Meso costs, rank-dependent maximum levels, Exalt expansion, and the progression paths unlocked at maximum level.

sections.title: What equipment leveling changes
items: Weapon levels increase attack and secondary options, while armor levels increase defense and secondary options.
Equipment of Legendary rank or lower can unlock Rank Up or Fuse after reaching maximum level.
Mythic or higher equipment can unlock Mastercraft after reaching maximum level.

sections.title: Access and material rules
items: Open Level Up from Bag > Equipment > Forge or Main Menu > Forge > Level Up.
Weapons and armor can use matching equipment, Whetstones, or Refining Powders as material.
Higher-rank material contributes more equipment EXP, and the process consumes Mesos.

sections.title: Maximum-level structure
items: Base maximum level rises by rank from Normal through Chaos equipment.
Mythic and higher equipment can expand its maximum level through Exalt.
The official table lists Chaos equipment at level 40 by default and up to level 60 or 70 with Exalt, depending on equipment.

sections.title: Level-up process and safeguards
items: Register the weapon or armor that will receive EXP, then register material items.
Equipped or locked equipment can be a base item but cannot be consumed as material.
Unlock a locked item only when it is intentionally being used as material.

notes: Structured summary verified from Nexon's official MapleStory M forum guide on 2026-07-27.
prerequisites: Compatible equipment, Whetstones, or Refining Powders
steps: Open Forge and select Level Up.
Register the base weapon or armor.
Register compatible material items or Refining Powders.
Review the resulting EXP and Meso cost.
Confirm the level-up operation and repeat until the intended level.
